message.content: Can you draft a quick invoice for the recent grape delivery? I need to send it to the distributor before the end of the day.

content.text: Certainly. I have the details from your last entry. Shall I include the standard payment terms of net 30 days?

message.content: Yes, that’s fine. Make sure to list the Cabernet Sauvignon separately from the Malbec. The pricing is different this season.

content.text: Noted. I’ve separated the two varietals and applied the updated unit prices. Do you want the subtotal to include the local transport fee we discussed last week?

message.content: No, keep the transport separate. It’s easier for them to process if they see the cost breakdown. Add the 21% tax to the final total.

content.text: Done. The invoice is ready for your review. Would you like me to save a copy to the shared cloud folder before sending?

message.content: Yes, please save it. Then send it to their accounts payable email. I’ll check the numbers in a moment.

content.text: The file has been saved and the email sent. I’ll notify you if they reply with any questions.
